.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model Dmodel D(Is=3.17e-05 n=1.373 Rs=0.051 Cjo=1.6e-10 Tt=0 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)

VR_LINE_SENSE n1 n_R_LINE_sense 0
R_LINE n_R_LINE_sense n2 1
VD1_SENSE n4 n_D1_sense 0

D1 n_D1_damp n2 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE n4 n_D2_sense 0

D2 n_D2_damp 0 Dmodel
VD3_SENSE n2 n_D3_sense 0

VD4_SENSE 0 n_D4_sense 0
RD4_SENSE_DAMP n_D4_sense n_D4_damp 0.001
D4 n_D4_damp n3 Dmodel
VR_LOAD_SENSE n3 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_sense n4 9

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

analysis_cirs.transient:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Single Phase Diode Bridge Rectifier
* Auto-grounded net 0 due to GND:pin
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model Dmodel D(Is=3.17e-05 n=1.373 Rs=0.051 Cjo=1.6e-10 Tt=0 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
VAC VAC_src 0 SIN(0 24 160)
RVAC_series VAC_src n1 0.001
VR_LINE_SENSE n1 n_R_LINE_sense 0
R_LINE n_R_LINE_sense n2 1
VD1_SENSE n4 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n2 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE n4 n_D2_sense 0
RD2_SENSE_DAMP n_D2_sense n_D2_damp 0.001
D2 n_D2_damp 0 Dmodel
VD3_SENSE n2 n_D3_sense 0
RD3_SENSE_DAMP n_D3_sense n_D3_damp 0.001
D3 n_D3_damp n3 Dmodel
VD4_SENSE 0 n_D4_sense 0
RD4_SENSE_DAMP n_D4_sense n_D4_damp 0.001
D4 n_D4_damp n3 Dmodel
VR_LOAD_SENSE n3 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_sense n4 9

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9
set hcopypscolor=1
set color0=white
set color1=black


* Transient Requirement tr_rectifier: Verify full-wave rectification and output ripple.
tran 1e-06 0.03 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let Vout_avg_diff = v(n3) - v(n4)
meas tran Vout_avg avg Vout_avg_diff from=0.024 to=0.03
print Vout_avg
let Vout_ripple_vpp_diff = v(n3) - v(n4)
meas tran Vout_ripple_vpp pp Vout_ripple_vpp_diff from=0.024 to=0.03
print Vout_ripple_vpp
wrdata time_series/tr_rectifier_VIN.csv v(n1)
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n3) - v(n4)
wrdata time_series/tr_rectifier_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
let v_R_LINE_auto = v(n1) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_R_LINE.csv v_R_LINE_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_LINE.csv i(VR_LINE_SENSE)
let v_D1_auto = v(n4) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_D1.csv v_D1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D1.csv i(VD1_SENSE)
let v_D2_auto = v(n4)
wrdata time_series/V_D2.csv v_D2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D2.csv i(VD2_SENSE)
let v_D3_auto = v(n2) - v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_D3.csv v_D3_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D3.csv i(VD3_SENSE)
let v_D4_auto = 0 - v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_D4.csv v_D4_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D4.csv i(VD4_SENSE)
let v_R_LOAD_auto = v(n3) - v(n4)
wrdata time_series/V_R_LOAD.csv v_R_LOAD_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_LOAD.csv i(VR_LOAD_SENSE)
plot v(n1) title 'tr_rectifier_VIN'
plot VOUT_csv_diff title 'tr_rectifier_VOUT'
plot v_R_LINE_auto title 'V_R_LINE'
plot i(VR_LINE_SENSE) title 'I_R_LINE'
plot v_D1_auto title 'V_D1'
plot i(VD1_SENSE) title 'I_D1'
plot v_D2_auto title 'V_D2'
plot i(VD2_SENSE) title 'I_D2'
plot v_D3_auto title 'V_D3'
plot i(VD3_SENSE) title 'I_D3'
plot v_D4_auto title 'V_D4'
plot i(VD4_SENSE) title 'I_D4'
plot v_R_LOAD_auto title 'V_R_LOAD'
plot i(VR_LOAD_SENSE) title 'I_R_LOAD'
.endc
